cmds.name: builtin
cmds.do:
set -eu
export DOCKER_HOST_TCP="$DOCKER_HOST"
export DEPOT_DISABLE_OTEL=1
docker compose --profile '*' config -o /tmp/ci-compose.yaml
docker buildx bake --allow=fs.read=/ -f /tmp/ci-compose.yaml --print ci-visual ci-replay ci-ledger > /tmp/ci-bake.json
for target in ci-visual ci-replay ci-ledger; do
 docker buildx bake -f /tmp/ci-bake.json --progress plain --set '*.output=type=cacheonly' ${SAYT_NO_CACHE:+--no-cache --set "*.cache-from=" --set "*.cache-to="} ${SAYT_NO_CACHE_FROM:+--set "*.cache-from="} ${SAYT_NO_CACHE_TO:+--set "*.cache-to="} "$target"
done

buildx-instance.name: buildx-instance
buildx-instance.pre:
if [ -n "$BUILDX_BUILDER" ] && [ -n "$BUILDX_INSTANCE" ]; then
  install -d -m 0700 /root/.docker/buildx/instances
  printf '%s' "$BUILDX_INSTANCE" > "/root/.docker/buildx/instances/$BUILDX_BUILDER"
  chmod 0600 "/root/.docker/buildx/instances/$BUILDX_BUILDER"
fi

        refs = [make_ref(), make_ref()]
